meta.note: Counts per 30 m fire cell (index r * W + c, r from the south edge; js/fire.js cellOf). Exposure context only: not ignition, not loss. No footprints, addresses or parcel data are stored.

sources.structures: City of Berkeley ArcGIS Online, Distance_between_structures_in_Fire_Zones_2_and_3_WFL1 layer 3 (edited 2023-09-13), fields NEAR_DIST and geometry only; counted at footprint centroids; gaps measured from the geometry (SOURCE_NOTES PH1, PH10)
sources.housingUnits: US Census 2020 blocks, HU100 at interior points (data/raw/census/blocks-2020.json), blocks outside Fire Zones 2–3 only (SOURCE_NOTES PH10)

provenance.structures: sourced (City footprints), counted per cell: derived
provenance.bands: derived: gap to the nearest footprint measured from the City geometry, in the NIST bands the City map uses (under 25 ft, 25–50 ft, 50 ft or more)
provenance.housingUnits: sourced (Census), placed at block interior points: derived
